body.p: In response to the Restriction Requirement set forth in the Office Action of 06-March- 2024, Applicant elects herewith the invention of Group I, claims 1-11 and 20.

The restriction requirement identifies the cryogenic tank of claims 12-19 to be a subcombination of the aircraft of claims 1-11 and 20. The restriction is based on the understanding that "invention I is operable without the use of cryogenic tank i.e., the aircraft can be operated by jet fuel stored on the structural wing box."
The Applicant respectfully traverses the restriction. To support a requirement for

restriction between combination and subcombination inventions, the combination as claimed must not require the particulars of the subcombination as claimed for patentability (to show novelty and unobviousness). See MPEP 806.05(c). Here, the restriction would be proper, if an aircraft, comprising an airframe configured to transmit aircraft flight loads, a propulsion system, and jet fuel stored on the structural wing box (as suggested by the Examiner) was not just operable but patentable. If that is the examiner's position, the Applicant will gladly accept the restriction and present such an allowable claim. If, however, the examiner finds that the aircraft of claim 1 requires the specifics of the cryogenic tank for patentability the restriction is in error and should be withdrawn.
